name: ogverdict
caption:
TONIGHT WE PLAY OG 🎮🏀 We traded him to the Knicks for RJ and IQ. Who won?

• Dec 30, 2023: OG, Precious Achiuwa and Malachi Flynn to New York for RJ Barrett, Immanuel Quickley and a second-round pick
• The Knicks then gave OG 5 years, $212.5 million
• OG this season: 16.0 a night on 38.0% shooting (first 12 games)
• RJ: 21.3 a night (first 12 games). IQ: 17.6 points, 5.6 assists (first 10 games)

Who won the trade? 👇

beats.head: WHO WON?
beats.name: OG
beats.vo: Tonight we play OG. We traded him to the Knicks for RJ and IQ. So who won the trade?
beats.dlg: TONIGHT WE PLAY OG.|WE TRADED HIM FOR RJ AND IQ.

beats.head: WHAT WE SENT
beats.name: OG
beats.vo: The Knicks paid OG two hundred and twelve million. This season: sixteen a night, on thirty-eight percent shooting.

beats.head: WHAT WE GOT
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: RJ? Twenty-one point three a night, and six point seven boards.

beats.head: AND IQ
beats.name: IQ
beats.vo: And IQ: seventeen point six points, five point six assists.

beats.head: WHO WON?
beats.vo: Two for one, and OG's on the other side tonight. Who won the trade? Comment below.
beats.dlg: TWO FOR ONE.|WHO WON THE TRADE?

facts.claim: On 30 December 2023 (Dec 30, 2023), the Raptors traded Anunoby, Precious Achiuwa and Malachi Flynn to the New York Knicks in exchange for RJ Barrett, Immanuel Quickley, and a second-round pick. On 6 July 2024, Anunoby re-signed with the Knicks on a five-year (5 years), $212.5 million contract.
